name: Akoum Skyclave
description: One of seven floating kor fortresses on Zendikar, shattered long ago and reawakened.

description_citations.text: "Akoum Skyclave". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the Makindi Empire crumbled, the Kargan tribes mastered Akoum's dragons and rode them to victory over the kor, shattering the Akoum Skyclave.
timeline.quote: the Kargan tribes mastered the dragons of Akoum and rode them to victory against the kor

citation.text: "Akoum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kargan tribes won a costly victory over the Akoum Skyclave.
timeline.quote: The Kargan tribes share legends of the victory their ancestors won over the Akoum Skyclave, and its horrendous cost.

citation.text: Soul Shatter (Zendikar Rising Promos, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Kargans, riding tamed dragons, shatter the Akoum Skyclave, ending Kor rule in the region.
timeline.quote: Their coordinated attacks ultimately succeeded in bringing down the Skyclave.

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kesenya's party activates Emeria's defenses and the Akoum fragments levitate again.
timeline.quote: its fragments began levitating once again

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Nissa ascend the Skyclave; Nahiri quells Roil tremors.
timeline.quote: Their exploration was interrupted by Roil tremors, which Nahiri quelled with lithomancy.

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They defeat a felidar guardian and survive a geopede trap.
timeline.quote: They survived a deadly geopede trap through teamwork

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri takes the lithoform core, calming the Roil but killing the fern elemental; they fight and Nissa planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Nissa chose to protect Zendikar alone and planeswalked away

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bello travels beyond Bloomburrow, collecting souvenirs from other worlds, including a hedron from the Akoum Skyclave.
timeline.quote: His crowning achievement, he'll add with a grin, is a hedron plucked from the highest point of the Akoum Skyclave.

citation.text: "Bello", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
